Build the full analysis grid for a sweep

Source: R/pipeline-grid.R
build_analysis_grid.Rd

One row per combination of model x research question x context variant x granularity x include_headlines — the unit _targets.R branches over via pattern = map(grid), dispatching each row to run_pipeline_with_schema() via rq_schema_for().

Usage

build_analysis_grid(
  models,
  research_questions = c("sentiment", "nationalism", "ugc"),
  context_variants = c("no_context", "ulysses_context", "media_text_context"),
  granularities = c("sentence", "microtext"),
  include_headlines = c(TRUE, FALSE),
  output_dir = "results"
)

Arguments

models

Character vector of Ollama model identifiers to sweep over

research_questions

Character vector, subset of "sentiment", "nationalism", "ugc"

context_variants

Character vector, subset of "no_context", "ulysses_context", "media_text_context"

granularities

Character vector, subset of "sentence", "microtext"

include_headlines

Logical vector, subset of TRUE/FALSE

output_dir

Directory the per-cell results CSVs are written under

Value

A tibble with one row per grid cell: model, research_question, context_variant, granularity, include_headlines, and output (a filesystem-safe, unique path under output_dir)
